affected_system: public digital services, identity, applications, appointments, and assisted access
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for multichannel administrative service and support demand
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for multichannel administrative service and support demand
pair service-event and journey-stage workload forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Page events, applications, errors, appointments, contacts, decisions, and outcomes remain distinct.
No automated score determines eligibility, enforcement, or denial without lawful human review.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for multichannel administrative service and support demand.

constraints.description: The digital public access and administrative service delivery forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: chief digital officer and administrative service delivery director
decision_question: What service, language, channel, device, and time-specific demand should support operations prepare for?
family_title: Digital public access and administrative service delivery

independence_key.binding_constraint: The digital public access and administrative service delivery forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.decision_object: multichannel administrative service and support demand
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for multichannel administrative service and support demand passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.primary_outcome: eligible journey demand above qualified channel capacity

intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting multichannel administrative service and support demand, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: eligible journey demand above qualified channel capacity
distributional gap in eligible journey demand above qualified channel capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call forecast contacts eligible applicants, completed services, or verified unmet need.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for multichannel administrative service and support demand passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

title: Forecast digital, phone, and in-person support demand
transportability_risks: Eligibility, identity, language, disability access, connectivity, trust, and service design differ.
Digital telemetry omits non-users and can encode device or tracking coverage.
